name: Canonical Compensation Drift Detector
purpose: Prevent mirrors, reposts and stale search indexes from inflating pay or creating false urgency when the canonical job detail states different compensation.

rules.locationGatePrecedence: Compensation never overrides ba-area/remote-ok hard eligibility.

rankingInvariant: Guaranteed-pay ranking must use the strongest canonical evidence and must not use a higher repost/mirror number when canonical evidence is lower or ambiguous.

example.case: canonical detail says 150 EUR/day while mirror says 180 EUR/day
example.result: rank and display guaranteed value from canonical 150 EUR/day; preserve 180 EUR/day only as observed conflict evidence
